receiver.target: Godot 4.7.2 GL Compatibility direct glTF skin import
receiver.skinned_variant: actual imported target mesh evaluated through Skeleton3D/Skin at exact neutral sample
receiver.detached_static_variant: same imported mesh surface POSITION/NORMAL/INDEX arrays copied into a new ArrayMesh with skin channels removed, using the imported mesh global transform
receiver.owner_reference_variant: exact owner neutral positions and area-weighted indexed smooth normals from the retained Materials reference
receiver.position_controls: unshaded comparisons between skinned target, detached imported static mesh, and owner reference

classification.purpose: localize the already-observed neutral shaded mismatch without changing source, skinning, animation, material scalars, or transport
classification.skin_path_localized_when: unshaded coverage stays aligned, detached imported static shading stays materially closer to owner reference than actual skinned target shading does
classification.pre_skin_or_transform_hold_when: detached imported static shading also substantially disagrees with owner reference
